critical_code_review_comments: nextVatDeadline: due date = 30th of the month, but Feb has no day 30; JS Date will roll over to March 1-2. For Q4 (deadline late Jan), this produces Feb 30 → Mar 2, which mislabels the deadline. Consider clamping or using an explicit day-30 rule with month-end fallback.

Cockpit does not filter by role (accountant/owner/member) — comment on line 30 says 'accountant/owner/member' but the query returns ALL memberships regardless of role. If cockpit is intended only for accountant/owner roles, add a role filter.

viva-iris-payment.tsx: pathname parsing `pathname.split('/')[2]` is fragile; assumes /p/<token>/... structure. If the component is reused elsewhere, this silently sends an empty token. Consider passing token as a prop.
viva/checkout route.ts: returns raw Viva error text (sliced to 200 chars) with status 502 — acceptable for now, but consider structured error mapping in production.
